description: Suggested gameplay stat import data. Default/range columns map to Unit.stats. Melee columns map to Unit.statsMelee.
importNotes: unitId currently comes from the No column. The Unity importer should match this to Unit.prefabID only if your UnitDB IDs match this column.
armorTypeName, damageTypeName, and damageTypeMeleeName are labels. The Unity importer should map them to DamageTableDB indices or leave existing prefab values if no mapping is configured.
factoryDataCost maps to your custom Unit factory cost field if present.
statsMelee contains melee-only fields used by Unit.cs melee getters.
